import type {
  RegistryPromptId,
  RegistryPromptIdByKind,
  RegistryPromptKind,
  TemplateDefinition,
} from "./response-template-registry";

/**
 * Prompt family discriminator.
 * Derived from the shared response template registry.
 */
export type PromptKind = RegistryPromptKind;

/**
 * Prompt ID constrained to a specific prompt kind.
 */
export type PromptIdByKind<K extends PromptKind> = RegistryPromptIdByKind<K>;

/**
 * Any valid prompt ID across all prompt kinds.
 */
export type PromptId = RegistryPromptId;

/**
 * Rendering mode for the response.
 */
export type ResponseMode =
  | "deterministic"
  | "grounded_expressive"
  | "generative_draft";

/**
 * Trust class attached to a response.
 */
export type ResponseTrust =
  | "authoritative"
  | "grounded"
  | "generated"
  | "disputed";

/**
 * Reply type expected from the user.
 */
export type ReplyType = "confirm" | "reject" | "choice" | "freeform" | null;

/**
 * Structured response option.
 */
export type ResponseOption = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
};

/**
 * Source citation metadata for grounded responses.
 */
export type ResponseCitation = {
  sourceType: "entity" | "document" | "chunk" | "assertion";
  sourceId: string;
  pageNumbers?: number[];
  label?: string;
};

/**
 * Deterministic card payload shape for rendered responses.
 */
export type ResponseCard = {
  id: string;
  label: string
};

/**
 * Semantic response contract produced by root/specialists and consumed by responseMachine.
 */
export type ResponseSpec<K extends PromptKind = PromptKind> = {
  responseId?: string;
  promptKind: K;
  promptId: PromptIdByKind<K>;
  promptInstanceId?: string | null;
  requesterMachine: string;
  relatedFlowId?: string | null;
  mode: ResponseMode;
  trust: ResponseTrust;
  expectedReplyType: ReplyType;
  cards: ResponseCard[];
  options?: ResponseOption[];
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
  citations?: ResponseCitation[];
};

/**
 * Union of all valid response specs across all prompt kinds.
 */
export type AnyResponseSpec = {
  [K in PromptKind]: ResponseSpec<K>;
}[PromptKind];

/**
 * Routed response-spec contract after root routing/hydration.
 * Requires identity fields needed by response preparation.
 */
export type RoutedResponseSpec<K extends PromptKind = PromptKind> = Omit<
  ResponseSpec<K>,
  "responseId" | "promptInstanceId"
> & {
  responseId: string;
  promptInstanceId: string | null;
};

/**
 * Union of all valid routed response specs across all prompt kinds.
 */
export type AnyRoutedResponseSpec = {
  [K in PromptKind]: RoutedResponseSpec<K>;
}[PromptKind];

/**
 * Normalized response preparation artifact used before rendering.
 */
export type PreparedResponse<K extends PromptKind = PromptKind> = {
  responseId: string;
  promptKind: K;
  promptId: PromptIdByKind<K>;
  promptInstanceId: string | null;
  requesterMachine: string;
  relatedFlowId?: string | null;
  template: TemplateDefinition<K, PromptIdByKind<K>>;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
  cards: ResponseCard[];
  options: ResponseOption[];
  citations: ResponseCitation[];
  mode: ResponseMode;
  trust: ResponseTrust;
  expectedReplyType: ReplyType;
};


/**
 * Rendered but not yet delivered response payload.
 *
 * Rendering contract:
 * - When llmRephraseAllowed === true, `text` is the primary final message text.
 * - When llmRephraseAllowed === false, `text` is the immutable deterministic core text,
 *   and the UI assembles final display text from `prefixFlavorText`, `text`,
 *   and `suffixFlavorText`.
 */
export type ResponseDraft<K extends PromptKind = PromptKind> = {
  responseId: string;
  promptKind: K;
  promptId: PromptIdByKind<K>;
  promptInstanceId: string | null;
  text: string;
  prefixFlavorText: string;
  suffixFlavorText: string;
  cards: ResponseCard[];
  options: ResponseOption[];
  citations: ResponseCitation[];
  mode: ResponseMode;
  trust: ResponseTrust;
  expectedReplyType: ReplyType;
  requesterMachine: string;
  relatedFlowId?: string | null;
};

function buildWorkflowRecord(input: {

  phase?: WorkflowCreateFlowPhase | null;

}): WorkflowRecord {

  const createDrafts = { flowId } as Record<string, unknown>;
  const responseSpec = buildResponseSpec(flowId);

}

describe("restart hydration", () => {
  it("falls back to currentMachineStateValue when snapshotRef.phase is absent", () => {
    const record = buildWorkflowRecord({
      flowId: "flow-1",
      phase: null,
      currentMachineStateValue: "save_pending",
    });

    const resumeInput = buildCreateDialogueResumeInput({
      record,
      campaignEntityIndex: null,
    });

    expect(resumeInput?.phase).toBe("save_pending");
    expect(resumeInput?.flowId).toBe("flow-1");
  });

  it("rejects blank flow IDs during create-dialogue hydration", async () => {
    const actor = createActor(createDialogueMachine, {
      input: {
        flowId: "   ",
        phase: "review_ready",
        draftRevision: 0,
        createPlan: null,
        createDrafts: null,
        responseSpec: null,
        responseBaseline: null,
        feedback: [],
        campaignEntityIndex: null,
      },
    });

    actor.start();

    const snapshot = await waitFor(actor, (state) => state.status === "done", {
      timeout: 2_500,
    });

    expect(snapshot.output?.status).toBe("failed");
    expect(snapshot.output?.error).toBe("create_dialogue_hydration_failed");

    actor.stop();
  });

  it("merges the supervised child patch into root hydration state", async () => {
    const record = buildWorkflowRecord({
      flowId: "flow-1",
      phase: "review_ready",
      currentMachineStateValue: "review_ready",
      status: "awaiting_review",
    });

    const normalized = normalizeWorkflowHydrationState({
      activeFlows: {
        [record.flowId]: record,
      },
      focusedFlowId: record.flowId,
      recentFlowIds: [record.flowId],
    });

    const hydrated = await hydrateRestartableCreateDialogues({
      context: {
        ...normalized,
        campaignEntityIndex: null,
      },
    });

    expect(hydrated.patch.focusedFlowId).toBe("flow-1");
    expect(hydrated.patch.currentTurn?.currentMachineStateValue).toBe("review_ready");
    expect(hydrated.patch.hydratedCreateDialogueFlowIds).toEqual(["flow-1"]);
    expect(hydrated.patch.hydratedCreateDialoguePhasesByFlowId?.["flow-1"]).toBe(
      "review_ready",
    );
  });

  it("canonicalizes whitespace-padded responseSpec related flow IDs during restart hydration", () => {
    const record = buildWorkflowRecord({
      flowId: "flow-1 ",
      phase: "review_ready",
      currentMachineStateValue: "review_ready",
    });

    const normalized = normalizeWorkflowHydrationState({
      activeFlows: {
        [record.flowId]: record,
      },
      focusedFlowId: record.flowId,
      recentFlowIds: [record.flowId],
    });

    expect(Object.keys(normalized.activeFlows)).toEqual(["flow-1"]);
    expect(normalized.activeFlows["flow-1"].responseSpec?.relatedFlowId).toBe("flow-1");
    expect(
      normalized.activeFlows["flow-1"].responseBaseline?.responseSpec?.relatedFlowId,
    ).toBe("flow-1");
  });

  it("rewrites persisted responseSpec flow IDs for renamed hydrated flows", () => {
    const firstRecord = buildWorkflowRecord({
      flowId: "flow-duplicate",
      phase: "review_ready",
      currentMachineStateValue: "review_ready",
      timingOffsetMs: 0,
    });
    const secondRecord = buildWorkflowRecord({
      flowId: "flow-duplicate",
      phase: "save_pending",
      currentMachineStateValue: "save_pending",
      timingOffsetMs: 100,
    });

    const normalized = normalizeWorkflowHydrationState({
      activeFlows: {
        first: firstRecord,
        second: secondRecord,
      },
      focusedFlowId: "flow-duplicate",
      recentFlowIds: ["flow-duplicate", "flow-duplicate__hydrated_2"],
    });

    expect(
      normalized.activeFlows["flow-duplicate__hydrated_2"].responseSpec?.relatedFlowId,
    ).toBe("flow-duplicate__hydrated_2");
    expect(
      normalized.activeFlows["flow-duplicate__hydrated_2"].responseBaseline?.responseSpec
        ?.relatedFlowId,
    ).toBe("flow-duplicate__hydrated_2");
  });

  it("skips malformed pending create-dialogue proposals during restart normalization", () => {
    const record = buildWorkflowRecord({
      flowId: "flow-1",
      phase: "review_ready",
      currentMachineStateValue: "review_ready",
    });

    const normalized = normalizeWorkflowHydrationState({
      activeFlows: {
        [record.flowId]: {
          ...record,
          pendingCreateDialogueProposals: [
            null as never,
            undefined as never,
            {
              flowId: record.flowId,
              baseDraftRevision: 0,
            } as never,
            {
              flowId: record.flowId,
              baseDraftRevision: 0,
              proposedDrafts: record.createDrafts as never,
            },
          ],
        },
      },
      focusedFlowId: record.flowId,
      recentFlowIds: [record.flowId],
    });

    expect(
      normalized.activeFlows[record.flowId].pendingCreateDialogueProposals,
    ).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(
      normalized.activeFlows[record.flowId].pendingCreateDialogueProposals?.[0].flowId,
    ).toBe(record.flowId);
  });

  it("keeps duplicate source flow IDs collision-safe and rewrites nested flow-bearing fields", async () => {
    const firstRecord = buildWorkflowRecord({
      flowId: "flow-duplicate",
      phase: "review_ready",
      currentMachineStateValue: "review_ready",

    const secondRecord = buildWorkflowRecord({

      timingOffsetMs: 100,
      includePendingProposal: true,

    const normalized = normalizeWorkflowHydrationState({
      activeFlows: {
        first: firstRecord,
        second: secondRecord,
      },
      focusedFlowId: "flow-duplicate",
      recentFlowIds: ["flow-duplicate", "flow-duplicate__hydrated_2"],
    });

    const hydrated = await hydrateRestartableCreateDialogues({
      context: {
        ...normalized,

    expect(Object.keys(normalized.activeFlows).sort()).toEqual([
      "flow-duplicate",
      "flow-duplicate__hydrated_2",
    ]);
    expect(normalized.focusedFlowId).toBe("flow-duplicate");
    expect(normalized.recentFlowIds).toEqual([

    expect(normalized.activeFlows["flow-duplicate"].createPlan?.flowId).toBe(

    expect(hydrated.patch.focusedFlowId).toBe("flow-duplicate");

import { createActor } from "xstate";

import type { CampaignEntityIndex } from "../../../domain/entities/index/campaignEntityIndex";
import type { ChatSendRootMachineV2Context } from "../../chatsendrootmachinev2";
import { machine as responsemachine } from "../../responsemachine";
import type { ResponseMachineOutput } from "../../responsemachine";
import {
  buildCreateDialogueResumeInput,
  resolveRestartableCreateWorkflowRecords,
  type CreateDialogueProposalSubmittedPayload,
  type WorkflowCreateFlowPhase,
  type WorkflowRecord,
  type WorkflowRestartHydrationState,
} from "./workflow-registry";
import type { AnyResponseSpec } from "./response/response-types";

function registerFlowIdAlias(
  flowIdAliases: Map<string, string[]>,
  sourceFlowId: string | null | undefined,
  normalizedFlowId: string,
): void {
  if (typeof sourceFlowId !== "string") {
    return;
  }

  const trimmedSourceFlowId = sourceFlowId.trim();
  if (trimmedSourceFlowId.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  const existingAliases = flowIdAliases.get(trimmedSourceFlowId) ?? [];
  if (!existingAliases.includes(normalizedFlowId)) {
    flowIdAliases.set(trimmedSourceFlowId, [...existingAliases, normalizedFlowId]);
  }
}

function normalizeWorkflowFlowId(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== "string") {
    return null;
  }

  const trimmed = value.trim();
  return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : null;
}

function isWorkflowCreateFlowPhase(
  value: unknown,
): value is WorkflowCreateFlowPhase {
  return (
    value === "dialogue_collecting" ||
    value === "gather_inputs" ||
    value === "review_ready" ||
    value === "save_pending"
  );
}

function normalizeWorkflowRecordFlowId(
  record: WorkflowRecord,
  fallbackFlowId?: string | null,
): WorkflowRecord {
  const canonicalFlowId =
    normalizeWorkflowFlowId(record.flowId) ??
    normalizeWorkflowFlowId(fallbackFlowId) ??
    record.flowId;

  const normalizedResponseSpec = normalizeResponseSpecFlowId(
    record.responseSpec,
    canonicalFlowId,
  );
  const normalizedCreatePlan =
    record.createPlan && record.createPlan.flowId !== canonicalFlowId
      ? { ...record.createPlan, flowId: canonicalFlowId }
      : record.createPlan;
  const normalizedPendingCreateDialogueProposals = normalizePendingCreateDialogueProposals(
    record.pendingCreateDialogueProposals,
    canonicalFlowId,
  );
  const normalizedResponseBaselineResponseSpec = normalizeResponseSpecFlowId(
    record.responseBaseline?.responseSpec,
    canonicalFlowId,
  );
  const normalizedResponseBaseline =
    record.responseBaseline &&
    (record.responseBaseline.flowId !== canonicalFlowId ||
      normalizedResponseBaselineResponseSpec !== record.responseBaseline.responseSpec)
      ? {
          ...record.responseBaseline,
          flowId: canonicalFlowId,
          responseSpec: normalizedResponseBaselineResponseSpec ?? null,
        }
      : record.responseBaseline;

  return canonicalFlowId === record.flowId &&
    normalizedResponseSpec === record.responseSpec &&
    normalizedCreatePlan === record.createPlan &&
    normalizedPendingCreateDialogueProposals === record.pendingCreateDialogueProposals &&
    normalizedResponseBaseline === record.responseBaseline
    ? record
    : {
        ...record,
        flowId: canonicalFlowId,
        responseSpec: normalizedResponseSpec,
        createPlan: normalizedCreatePlan,
        pendingCreateDialogueProposals: normalizedPendingCreateDialogueProposals,
        responseBaseline: normalizedResponseBaseline,
      };
}

function normalizeResponseSpecFlowId(
  responseSpec: AnyResponseSpec | null | undefined,
  canonicalFlowId: string,
): AnyResponseSpec | null | undefined {
  if (!responseSpec) {
    return responseSpec;
  }

  const relatedFlowId = normalizeWorkflowFlowId(responseSpec.relatedFlowId);
  if (relatedFlowId !== canonicalFlowId) {
    return {
      ...responseSpec,
      relatedFlowId: canonicalFlowId,
    };
  }

  return responseSpec.relatedFlowId === canonicalFlowId
    ? responseSpec
    : {
        ...responseSpec,
        relatedFlowId: canonicalFlowId,
      };
}

function isNonArrayObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function isValidPendingCreateDialogueProposal(
  proposal: unknown,
): proposal is CreateDialogueProposalSubmittedPayload {
  if (!isNonArrayObject(proposal)) {
    return false;
  }

  if (normalizeWorkflowFlowId(proposal.flowId) === null) {
    return false;
  }

  if (!isNonArrayObject(proposal.proposedDrafts)) {
    return false;
  }

  return typeof proposal.baseDraftRevision === "number";
}

function normalizePendingCreateDialogueProposals(
  proposals: WorkflowRecord["pendingCreateDialogueProposals"],
  canonicalFlowId: string,
): WorkflowRecord["pendingCreateDialogueProposals"] {
  if (!Array.isArray(proposals)) {
    return proposals;
  }

  let changed = false;
  const normalizedProposals = proposals.reduce<CreateDialogueProposalSubmittedPayload[]>(
    (accumulator, proposal) => {
      if (!isValidPendingCreateDialogueProposal(proposal)) {
        changed = true;
        return accumulator;
      }

      const proposalFlowId = normalizeWorkflowFlowId(proposal.flowId);
      if (proposalFlowId !== canonicalFlowId) {
        changed = true;
        accumulator.push({
          ...proposal,
          flowId: canonicalFlowId,
        });
        return accumulator;
      }

      accumulator.push(proposal as CreateDialogueProposalSubmittedPayload);
      return accumulator;
    },
    [],
  );

  return changed || normalizedProposals.length !== proposals.length
    ? normalizedProposals
    : proposals;
}

export function normalizeWorkflowHydrationState(
  input: WorkflowRestartHydrationState | null,
): Required<WorkflowRestartHydrationState> {
  const collisionCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  const flowIdAliases = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const activeFlows = Object.entries(input?.activeFlows ?? {}).reduce(
    (accumulator, [hydrationFlowId, record]) => {
      const normalizedRecord = normalizeWorkflowRecordFlowId(record, hydrationFlowId);
      const normalizedRecordFlowId =
        typeof normalizedRecord.flowId === "string" && normalizedRecord.flowId.trim().length > 0
          ? normalizedRecord.flowId.trim()
          : null;
      const normalizedHydrationFlowId =
        typeof hydrationFlowId === "string" && hydrationFlowId.trim().length > 0
          ? hydrationFlowId.trim()
          : null;
      const canonicalFlowId = normalizedRecordFlowId ?? normalizedHydrationFlowId;

      if (!canonicalFlowId) {
        return accumulator;
      }

      const occurrenceIndex = collisionCounts.get(canonicalFlowId) ?? 0;
      let normalizedFlowId =
        occurrenceIndex === 0 ? canonicalFlowId : `${canonicalFlowId}__hydrated_${occurrenceIndex + 1}`;

      while (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(accumulator, normalizedFlowId)) {
        const nextOccurrenceIndex = (collisionCounts.get(canonicalFlowId) ?? occurrenceIndex) + 1;
        collisionCounts.set(canonicalFlowId, nextOccurrenceIndex);
        normalizedFlowId = `${canonicalFlowId}__hydrated_${nextOccurrenceIndex + 1}`;
      }

      collisionCounts.set(canonicalFlowId, occurrenceIndex + 1);
      const normalizedResponseSpec = normalizeResponseSpecFlowId(
        normalizedRecord.responseSpec,
        normalizedFlowId,
      );
      const normalizedResponseBaselineResponseSpec = normalizeResponseSpecFlowId(
        normalizedRecord.responseBaseline?.responseSpec,
        normalizedFlowId,
      );
      const normalizedResponseBaseline =
        normalizedRecord.responseBaseline &&
        (normalizedRecord.responseBaseline.flowId !== normalizedFlowId ||
          normalizedResponseBaselineResponseSpec !== normalizedRecord.responseBaseline.responseSpec)
          ? {
              ...normalizedRecord.responseBaseline,
              flowId: normalizedFlowId,
              responseSpec: normalizedResponseBaselineResponseSpec ?? null,
            }
          : normalizedRecord.responseBaseline;
      const normalizedCurrentMachineStateValue =
        normalizedRecord.currentMachineStateValue ?? normalizedRecord.snapshotRef?.phase ?? null;
      const normalizedActiveRecord =
        normalizedRecordFlowId === normalizedFlowId &&
        normalizedResponseSpec === normalizedRecord.responseSpec &&
        normalizedResponseBaseline === normalizedRecord.responseBaseline &&
        normalizedCurrentMachineStateValue === normalizedRecord.currentMachineStateValue
          ? normalizedRecord
          : {
              ...normalizedRecord,
              flowId: normalizedFlowId,
              responseSpec: normalizedResponseSpec,
              currentMachineStateValue: normalizedCurrentMachineStateValue,
              createPlan:
                normalizedRecord.createPlan && normalizedRecord.createPlan.flowId !== normalizedFlowId
                  ? {
                      ...normalizedRecord.createPlan,
                      flowId: normalizedFlowId,
                    }
                  : normalizedRecord.createPlan,
              pendingCreateDialogueProposals: normalizePendingCreateDialogueProposals(
                normalizedRecord.pendingCreateDialogueProposals,
                normalizedFlowId,
              ),
              responseBaseline: normalizedResponseBaseline,
            };
      registerFlowIdAlias(flowIdAliases, hydrationFlowId, normalizedFlowId);
      registerFlowIdAlias(flowIdAliases, normalizedRecordFlowId, normalizedFlowId);
      registerFlowIdAlias(flowIdAliases, normalizedRecord?.responseBaseline?.flowId, normalizedFlowId);

      accumulator[normalizedFlowId] = normalizedActiveRecord;
      return accumulator;
    },
    {} as Record<string, WorkflowRecord>,
  );
  const normalizedActiveFlowIds = new Set(Object.keys(activeFlows));
  const resolveNormalizedFlowId = (flowId: string | null | undefined): string | null => {
    if (typeof flowId !== "string") {
      return null;
    }

    const trimmedFlowId = flowId.trim();
    if (trimmedFlowId.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    if (normalizedActiveFlowIds.has(trimmedFlowId)) {
      return trimmedFlowId;
    }

    return flowIdAliases.get(trimmedFlowId)?.[0] ?? null;
  };
  const recentFlowIds = Array.isArray(input?.recentFlowIds)
    ? input.recentFlowIds
        .map((flowId) => resolveNormalizedFlowId(flowId))
        .filter((flowId): flowId is string => flowId !== null)
        .filter((flowId, index, array) => array.indexOf(flowId) === index)
    : [];
  const focusedFlowId =
    resolveNormalizedFlowId(input?.focusedFlowId ?? null);

  return {
    activeFlows,
    focusedFlowId,
    recentFlowIds,
  };
}

function resolveRestartableCreateDialoguesForHydration(
  context: Pick<ChatSendRootMachineV2Context, "activeFlows" | "focusedFlowId" | "recentFlowIds">,
): WorkflowRecord[] {
  return resolveRestartableCreateWorkflowRecords({
    activeFlows: context.activeFlows,
    focusedFlowId: context.focusedFlowId,
    recentFlowIds: context.recentFlowIds,
  });
}

export async function hydrateRestartableCreateDialogues(input: {
  context: Pick<
    ChatSendRootMachineV2Context,
    | "activeFlows"
    | "focusedFlowId"
    | "recentFlowIds"
    | "campaignEntityIndex"
  >;
}): Promise<{
  hydratedFlowIds: string[];
  patch: Partial<ChatSendRootMachineV2Context>;
}> {
  const restartableCreateWorkflows = resolveRestartableCreateDialoguesForHydration(
    input.context,
  );
  const hydratedFlowIds: string[] = [];
  const hydratedCreateDialoguePhasesByFlowId: Record<
    string,
    WorkflowCreateFlowPhase | null
  > = {};
  let hydratedRootPatch: Partial<ChatSendRootMachineV2Context> | null = null;

  for (const record of restartableCreateWorkflows) {
    const hydratedCreateDialogue = buildCreateDialogueResumeInput({
      record,
      campaignEntityIndex: input.context.campaignEntityIndex as CampaignEntityIndex | null,
    });

    if (!hydratedCreateDialogue) {
      continue;
    }

    try {
      const actor = createActor(responsemachine, {
        input: {
          mode: "create_dialogue" as const,
          responseSpec: hydratedCreateDialogue.responseSpec,
          createDialogue: hydratedCreateDialogue,
        },
      });

      actor.start();
      const snapshot = actor.getSnapshot() as {
        output?: ResponseMachineOutput;
      };

      if (snapshot.output?.status === "create_dialogue_supervised") {
        const hydratedPhase = snapshot.output.phase ?? hydratedCreateDialogue.phase ?? null;

        if (!hydratedRootPatch && snapshot.output.patch) {
          hydratedRootPatch = {
            ...(snapshot.output.patch as Partial<ChatSendRootMachineV2Context>),
          };
        }

        hydratedFlowIds.push(snapshot.output.flowId);
        hydratedCreateDialoguePhasesByFlowId[snapshot.output.flowId] = hydratedPhase;
      }
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
  }

  return {
    hydratedFlowIds,
    patch: {
      ...(hydratedRootPatch ?? {}),
      hydratedCreateDialogueFlowIds: hydratedFlowIds,
      hydratedCreateDialoguePhasesByFlowId,
    },
  };
}

# Story 4.2: Rehydrate create dialogue from persisted workflow state on restart
Status: review

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Given the process restarts during an active create flow, when root reloads active workflow records, then it can recreate the `createDialogueMachine(flowId)` child from persisted workflow artifacts.
2. Given child-local memory is lost, when the child is recreated, then workflow truth remains intact because root owned the authoritative state.

## Latest Review Findings

## Tasks / Subtasks
- [x] Canonicalize persisted `responseSpec.relatedFlowId` during restart hydration.
  - [x] Rewrite the stored `responseSpec` object whenever the hydrated canonical flow ID differs or only matches after trimming.
  - [x] Add regression coverage for a renamed or whitespace-padded `relatedFlowId` that must still reattach correctly after restart.
- [x] Harden pending proposal hydration against malformed entries.
  - [x] Validate each proposal item before reading `proposal.flowId` or dereferencing nested `proposedDrafts` fields.
  - [x] Skip or reject malformed items during normalization and add regression coverage for null/undefined and partial proposal objects.

## Completion Notes
- Restart hydration now canonicalizes whitespace-padded `responseSpec.relatedFlowId` values and rejects malformed pending proposals missing required nested draft bundles.
